findings.text: The company status is recorded as 'liquidation', and the insolvency record shows a creditors voluntary liquidation with the company wound up on 20 March 2026.
The accounts are overdue, with the next accounts due 30 November 2025 and the last accounts made up to 29 February 2024.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 11 November 2025 and the next is due 25 November 2026.
Two charges are registered as outstanding, with none part-satisfied or satisfied.
The company was incorporated on 9 February 2022 and has one current officer, a director, PERSON 292, appointed on 7 November 2025.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 292 was appointed as director and PERSON 293 resigned as director, both on 7 November 2025.
One registered office address change was filed on 1 April 2026.
The sole person with significant control is PERSON 301, an individual holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and 75 to 100 percent of voting rights.

headline.text: CANARY-A18 (company number 91000424) is in liquidation following a creditors voluntary liquidation, with its accounts overdue and two outstanding charges on record.
